controles.affirmation: Titre : 'Un rappel mondial de lait infantile qui coute encore des parts de marche dix-huit mois plus tard' ; et dans le corps : 'le fait que les parts de marche soient encore degradees dans les trois zones dix-huit mois apres'.
controles.verbatim_source: In January 2026, Nestle launched a global precautionary recall of batches of infant formula... (communique annuel 2025, 18 fevrier 2026). Le constat de parts de marche degradees provient du communique semestriel 2026, date du 23 juillet 2026. L'ecart entre le rappel et ce constat est de SIX mois, pas dix-huit. Le corps de l'ATT se contredit d'ailleurs lui-meme : il ecrit deux phrases plus haut 'six mois apres le rappel, la ste ecrit que ses parts de marche en Nutrition restent en recul'.
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer 'dix-huit mois' par 'six mois' aux deux occurrences (titre et fin d'argument). Titre corrige : 'Un rappel mondial de lait infantile qui coute encore des parts de marche six mois plus tard'.

controles.affirmation: Rappel mondial de lots de lait infantile en janvier 2026 apres detection de cereulide venue d'un ingredient fourni par un fournisseur du secteur.
controles.verbatim_source: In January 2026, Nestle launched a global precautionary recall of batches of infant formula after detecting the presence of cereulide, caused by an ingredient sourced from a global industry supplier.

controles.affirmation: Rappel volontaire plus strict que la limite reglementaire europeenne (0,2 ng/g contre 0,43 ng/g).
controles.verbatim_source: The recall removed all batches of products that could potentially contain a level of cereulide >=0.2 ng/g in infant formula powder. This is more stringent than the action limit for recalls of 0.43 ng/g recently defined by the EU and being implemented across the bloc.

controles.affirmation: Le rappel a retire environ 90 points de base de croissance organique au T1 2026 et 30 points de base au T2 ; Nutrition seule categorie en recul au S1 2026 (-1,2%).
controles.verbatim_source: Nutrition OG was -1.2%... The infant formula recall had an impact on group OG of approximately 90 bps in Q1 and 30 bps in Q2. We expect to regain share by the end of the year.

controles.affirmation: 75 M CHF de retours de ventes et 110 M CHF de depreciations de stocks comptabilises en 2025.
controles.verbatim_source: Related to the infant formula recall, 2025 results include the estimated impact of sales returns (CHF (75) million in UTOP) and inventory write-offs (CHF (110) million in other operating expenses). The impact of sales returns on OG and RIG will be recognized in 2026.

controles.affirmation: Parts de marche Nutrition encore en recul dans les trois zones (Ameriques, AOA, Europe).
controles.verbatim_source: with some share loss in Nutrition (Zone Ameriques) ; Nutrition market share remained under pressure (Zone AOA) ; In Nutrition, market share remains impacted by the infant formula recall (Zone Europe).

controles.affirmation: Le rapport annuel 2025 fait apparaitre un risque principal 'Perception of food processing' qui n'existait pas sous cette forme l'annee precedente, sorti du bloc 'Regulation', avec quatre consequences potentielles listees.
controles.verbatim_source: Annual Review 2025 : risque 'Perception of food processing', description 'Prolonged negative perceptions concerning health implications of processed food and beverage categories', impacts 'Increase in regulation and/or taxes...', 'Erosion of consumer confidence in industry', 'Limitations on marketing, labeling and distribution', 'Litigation'. Annual Review 2024 : meme description et memes quatre impacts, sous le libelle 'Regulation'. Le renommage est donc reel et l'ATT le dit explicitement ; a noter que la description et les impacts sont identiques mot pour mot d'une annee sur l'autre, seules changent l'etiquette et une mitigation ajoutee.

controles.affirmation: Dette nette 56 344 M CHF pour 29 504 M CHF de capitaux propres au 30 juin 2026, soit 1,91 fois ; dette nette 51,4 Mds CHF au 31 decembre 2025 ; dividende de 8,0 Mds CHF verse.
controles.verbatim_source: Net financial debt 56 344 ; Total equity 29 504 (33 058 au 31.12.2025) ; Net debt was CHF 56.3 billion as at June 30, 2026, compared to CHF 51.4 billion as at December 31, 2025... largely reflected cash outflows for the dividend payment of CHF 8.0 billion. Ratio recalcule : 1,909.

controles.affirmation: Depreciation non monetaire de 1,3 Md CHF au S1 2026 liee au classement en actifs destines a la vente ; actifs destines a la vente a 5 451 M CHF contre 208 M CHF fin 2025 ; coentreprise eaux valorisee 4,5 Mds CHF, 2,8 Mds CHF attendus.
controles.verbatim_source: Other operating expenses was negatively impacted by a non-cash write-down of CHF 1.3 billion as we classify the businesses we are divesting as 'assets held for sale' ; Assets held for sale 5 451 / 208 ; It assigns an enterprise value of EUR 4.9 billion (CHF 4.5 billion) to Peranel, implying cash proceeds for Nestle of approximately EUR 3.0 billion (CHF 2.8 billion) at closing.

controles.affirmation: Resultat net -31,4% au S1 2026 a 3 472 M CHF, apres -17,0% en 2025 a 9 033 M CHF ; CA 89 490 M CHF en 2025 (-2,0%) et 43 109 M CHF au S1 2026 (-2,5%).
controles.verbatim_source: Net profit 3 472 / 5 065 / -31.4% ; Sales 43 109 / 44 228 / -2.5% (communique semestriel 2026). Net profit 9,033 / 10,884 / -17.0% ; Sales 89,490 / 91,354 / -2.0% (communique annuel 2025).

controles.affirmation: Dividende propose de 3,10 CHF representant 88% du BPA publie de 3,51 CHF ; ratio dette nette / EBITDA ajuste de 2,85x ; flux de tresorerie disponible 9,2 Mds CHF en 2025.
controles.verbatim_source: Free cash flow of CHF 9.2 billion... net debt/Adjusted EBITDA 2.85x; proposed dividend per share increased to CHF 3.10 ; Basic EPS (CHF) 3.51 / 4.19 / -16.3%. Ratio recalcule : 88,3%.

Targeted growth investments helped drive strong RIG acceleration from 0.2% in H1-25 to 1.4% in H2 (communique annuel 2025) ; RIG was 1.5% in the first half, improving from 1.2% in Q1 to 1.8% in Q2 (communique semestriel 2026) ; Real internal growth (RIG) -0.3% (FY2023) ; 0.8% / -0.3% (FY2024).

controles.affirmation: Trois dirigeants successifs recenses au rapport de remuneration 2025 ; Pablo Isla succede a Paul Bulcke le 1er octobre 2025 ; quatre mouvements au Comite de direction en 2025 ; Freixe sans indemnite de depart.
controles.verbatim_source: Steve Presley left the Executive Board on May 1, 2025 ; Jeff Hamilton was appointed member of the Executive Board effective July 1, 2025 ; Laurent Freixe left the Executive Board on September 1, 2025 ; Alfonso Gonzalez was appointed member of the Executive Board effective November 1, 2025 ; Board member since January 1, 2025 and CEO since September 1, 2025 ; Former CEO Laurent Freixe received no compensation upon termination other than his pro rata base salary until Sept. 1, 2025 ; Pablo Isla succeeded Paul Bulcke as Chair.

controles.affirmation: Plan de transformation : 16 000 suppressions de postes, 3,0 Mds CHF d'economies.
controles.verbatim_source: In Q4 2025, we announced an acceleration of planned global headcount reductions to c. 16,000... Growth cost savings of CHF 3.0 billion by the end of 2027.
